text: Original bilingual lesson scenes and English explanations authored for these courses. Common Patterns Master lessons include a second related review case from the authored Spanish 102 scenes. Conjugation reuses selected narrative contexts while its ten-verb models, cards and checked forms carry the exact focus.

frequentVerbs.selection: Appendix 1, first 60 verb lemmas in the adult spoken C-ORAL-ROM column, in that column's order.
frequentVerbs.limitation: A specific adult speech sample, not a universal or current worldwide frequency ranking. Regional meanings are explained.

usageFirstVerbs.selection: First 60 verb lemmas in descending source frequency, without reordering for teaching. Only rank, lemma and count facts are retained; definitions and lesson prose are original.
usageFirstVerbs.inflectedForms: Grouped under the infinitive lemma; these are not separate entries for soy, eres and es.
usageFirstVerbs.limitation: Web corpus ranking differs from spoken conversation and from other periods or regions.

framework: 28 deliberately named teaching families, not a claim that Spanish has exactly 28 tenses. The first 28 lessons introduce each family once; 32 subsequent lessons revisit a single family. Every lesson has ten distinct verbs. Latin American reference persons use ustedes; vosotros and voseo are outside this course. Commands show only meaningful addressees; imperfect subjunctive practices the -ra alternative.
commonStructures: 60 useful everyday constructions ordered for instruction, with exactly three focused cloze checks each. No unmeasured statistical rank is asserted for the structures.

audio.coverage: See audio-coverage.json; only published, verified successful files count.
